strings.VOR_communist_party_long: Upravlenie Ispravitel'no-Trudovikh Lagerey i Koloniy Narodnogo Komissariata Vnutrennykh Del Vorkutinskoy Sovetskoy Respubliki
strings.VOR_security_state_desc:
The state of Vorkuta made its origins with the NKVD officers sent to guard and survey the armies of prisoners of war, political prisoners, and violent criminals sent to pillage the vast resources of the region. From the era of the Front onwards, and past the West Russian War, the NKVD was granted free reign to rule the province as they saw fit, to maximize the crucial resources needed to keep the war machine in the West operational.

One can say they were cruel, and that they were brutal, perhaps unnecessarily so. But one cannot say that they were incompetent. The NKVD of Vorkuta, now swollen with volunteers and 'rehabilitated' prisoners is a formidable machine, with truly fearful capabilities in the field of combat, security, and intelligence-gathering.
strings.VOR_inhospitable_climate_desc: Vorkuta's climate, to put it as lightly as anyone is likely to, is brutally cold and unforgiving. In many parts of the region, permafrost cakes the ground, agriculture is impossible, and hunting is unfruitful. Unwinterized equipment is liable to freeze, and ill-prepared soldiers are liable to suffer. To fight in these harsh conditions is not a prospect one should take lightly, or approach with anything other than caution and acceptance of the dangers involved.
strings.VOR_pechora_war_desc: The Pechora War is the latest squabble between the two northern states of Vorkuta and Yugra. However, this time, both parties intend to finish what they started.
strings.VOR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
The Vorkuta Corrective Labor Camp, colloquially called Vorkuta, is a polity situated within the northern reaches of Russia. Its proximity to the Arctic Circle has ensured that the location is well known for its extremely low temperatures. This remote area was the site of the notorious Gulag camps, built for prisoners during the Soviet era. The region has built itself upon prison labour with the sole purpose of obtaining valuable minerals deep within the region's crust.

Since the fall of the Soviet Union, the situation in Vorkuta has worsened. The inmates within the camps have been subject to increasing degradation of material conditions while the prisoner population has been expanding as refugees fleeing from the West Russian War were, out of desperation, forced to work in the mines of Vorkuta. The NKVD also known as the The People's Commissariat for Internal Affairs acts as the main apparatus of the state.
strings.VOR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
The Director of the Vorkutlag, Vasily Blokhin, has established a tight grip on power which was acquired using morally dubious methods. Many observers question the humanity of the Vorkuta administration in its treatment of its population, the country, not to mention prisoners. While the Secretary's administration spends its time living in comfort, the rest of the population is forced to gradually die in poverty, from hypothermia or exhaustion due to forced labor in prisons and labor camps across the country.

However, there are signs of weaknesses within the NKVD. Vsevolod Merkulov and Sergey Kruglov, both partners who seem to be plotting against Blokhin. Even if they do agree to anything, Stepan Garanin, the hard-liner, seemingly turns down their propositions. In general, it seems that over time it is becoming increasingly difficult for the leader to maintain balanced relations with his Party members.
strings.VOR_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3:
It is quite obvious that with such a slavery system of a Vorkuta, it is impossible for opposition to the government to exist. However, there is another faction of Apolitical sailors who, after the end of the West Russian War, decided to serve in the Vorkuta warlord. The main explanation for this turn of events is the occupation of the russian archipelago of Novaya Zemlya by the German Kriegsmarine, and the threat of subjugation of the vulnerable Vorkuta, which did not have its own fleet.

Under the conditions of the collapse of the Soviet centralized power, Arseniy Golovko, commander of the Northern Fleet, in hatred of the nazis, decided to serve the most ruthless Russian military commander. By building the new main naval port in Usinsk, on the border with the WRRF, and conducting frequent diplomatic trips to western neighbor, Golovko hopes to finally find a successful opportunity, the strength and means to strike at Blokhin at the most unexpected moment, overthrowing the tyrant from the throne.

strings.VOR_news.1.desc:
Disturbing news comes from the harsh russian Tundra in the north of the Ural Mountains. According to the testimonies of observers and border guards of Zlatoust, two former natural enemies - the Thief Territory of Yugra and the ruthless Vorkuta NKVD - have resumed hostilities against each other. The conflict, which has become a protracted confrontation since the general uprising of prisoners after the collapse of the Soviet Union and was characterized only by border skirmishes.

It is difficult to determine who opened fire first, because in one of the Vorkuta gulags in the region, bandits revolted, disarmed the guards and actually took control of the surround area. Former prisoners turned to Jaba Ioseliani for help, so that his thief country would help all imprisoned criminals in this hellish totalitarian state. But there are also reports of an NKVD soldiers offensive in the Solekhard direction. Most likely, both sides this time are seriously determined to finally defeat their hated enemy.
strings.VOR_news.1.a: Nothing New Among the Russian Wreckage
strings.VOR_news.1.c: We Give Freedom to the Oppressed!
strings.VOR_news.2.desc:
What began as the philosophical reflections of the head of NKVD and chief of the Gulags in Vorkuta ended with the creation of an overwhelming force in Western Siberia linked to its exploitative and totalitarian ideology. Vasily Blokhin, who before the Pechora War was an open supporter of isolationism, in the end, after a brilliant victory in the war against bandits, dared to challenge other warlord states in the whole region.

The Secretary's dominance of Western Siberia and his 'workerist' dictatorship, which exists thanks to the forced labor of the majority of the population, caused some curiosity - and more so hatred - from other Russian states. Communists from all over the world condemn Blokhin's system, branding the newly formed state “the Russian Ordensstaat Burgund”. However detestable the old man may be, it's clear that the new ideology paved Blokhin's path to complete control of Russia, which he has yet to fully accomplish.
strings.VOR_news.2.a: Let's put an end to warlordism and unemployment!
strings.VOR_news.2.b: A country forged from weapons and forced labor?
strings.VOR_news.3.desc:
Having started out as a mere enforcer of sentences against convicts and having ruled over Vorkutlag as a warlord, Vasily Blokhin, is now the undisputed General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Labor Union. He proclaimed the creation, in accordance with his vision, of the Union of Soviet Labor Republics, much to applause of the present secret police.

By actively deploying the operative forces of the NKVD to maintain its dictatorial power as a method of intimidation and control, the new Soviet Union adopted a radically different course compared to previous governments. The so-called “securocratic-workerist revolution”, announced by Blokhin, has made his regime the target of significant criticism by the international left, which are not yet ready to establish new diplomatic ties with the new Union. The head of the NKVD has already effectively driven his country into international isolation, and the question of the future viability of a nation at odds with everyone around it remains open.
strings.VOR_news.3.a: Our securocratic-workerist revolution will triumph over the bourgeoisie!
strings.VOR_news.3.b: The Russian authorities, who deprived their own people of their rights?
strings.VOR_news.4.desc:
In the Russian Arctic, far removed from the comforts of civilization and subjected to unbearable conditions, the former Soviet Northern Fleet languished. However, through their service to the radical tyrant Blokhin, the sailors came to hold political views directly opposed to communist theory, which had been clearly distorted east of the Urals.

However, led by the authoritative President Arseniy Golovko, all apolitical forces in the country were able to overthrow the paranoid dictator. A fleet admiral was elected president, who announced the beginning of democratization and inevitable punishment for representatives of totalitarian dictatorial regimes in Russian-controlled territory. The new federal government exists in a precarious balance between conservative-minded reformist sailors and influential generals from the socialist faction. Nevertheless, despite the differences arising between the two political forces, all sides are united by a common goal - to build a democratic and independent {vor_getname}.
strings.VOR_news.4.a: The idealists of the Russian Arctic who overthrew the tyrants!
strings.VOR_news.5.desc:
Unexpected news is coming in from a traditional country in Southwest Asia: Maoist communists have attempted to overthrow the Shah’s regime! Zahir Shah’s regime faced its most dangerous challenges due to the gradual intensification of protests and the spread of more black-market weapons among the most radical elements in society.

Having launched a widespread local uprising in the north of the country, the Maoist revolutionaries demanded that the Shah step down, a fair transfer of power to a newly formed socialist council, amnesty for the rebels, and the allocation of state funds for development and infrastructure. However, the capital was well-protected by a loyal guard, which prevented a popular uprising in Kabul led by armed militants under the command of Akram Yari. Following the defeat of his forces, Yari went underground; his current whereabouts are unknown. This defeat marked the beginning of a new period of government repression against the republican opposition.
strings.VOR_news.5.a: Another “Red Revolution” has, as Expected, Failed
strings.VOR_news.6.t: {get_newspaper_header}The Soviet Military Machine Challenges the Einheitspakt
strings.VOR_news.6.desc:
Tensions along the German-Soviet border reached a fever pitch yesterday when {vor_getleader}, General Secretary of the Union of Soviet Labor Republics, announced the start of the Second Great Patriotic War. Columns of tanks, squadrons of aircraft, and ranks of infantry stormed the RK Moskowien, clearly fueled by state propaganda. Under the banner of the Labor State, the struggle was not so much for the return of all former Soviet territories, but rather for the supremacy of the Securocratic-Workerist ideology over National Socialism.

{vor_getleader} promised all friendly, socialist, and communist governments around the world that Russia would destroy its natural Nazi enemy. The evil empire, which had so long bled dry and crushed the might of the Russian people into the ground, would finally be defeated. For its part, the German propaganda machine compares the new Soviet Union to a 'feudal kingdom of mad rulers', aimed primarily at bolstering the morale of its soldiers. Nevertheless, one can only guess whose ideological rhetoric will prove more effective in this bloody war.
strings.VOR_news.6.a: This showdown could change the world
strings.VOR_news.7.t: {get_newspaper_header}The Federation Declares War on Nazi Oppression
strings.VOR_news.7.desc:
In a speech that would determine the future of an entire generation, Arseniy Golovko, President of the {vor_getname}, declared war on the Greater Germanic Reich. Golovko declared that the Federation would deploy 'all available types of troops', including the air force and navy, to drive the Nazi occupiers from legitimate Russian lands and liberate the enslaved Russian people.

The German Führer, {ger_getleader}, warned the naval enthusiast that the land is not his battlefield, and that within a matter of months, his actions will lead Russia only to its grave. Both sides are determined to win, continuing their military mobilizations and building up their arsenals. The world holds its breath once again as the Reich and Russia battle for the fate of Eastern Europe and the world as we know it.
strings.VOR_news.7.a: There will be no negotiations until one side has secured a decisive victory?

strings.VOR_nkvd_supremacy_desc: With complete control over Vorkuta's domestic and foreign policy, the NKVD firmly established itself in the country's leadership, no longer sharing power with civilians. Under these conditions, the party gradually faded into the background, forced to merely confirm all the ill-fated directives, laws, and orders issued by the NKVD.
strings.VOR_Blokhins_grip_desc:
“So much time wasted, so many missed opportunities for a decent life, so many souls lost...”

These are the thoughts that haunt the slaves—the modern-day prisoners without any rights in the Gulags, forced to work all day and sometimes even at night. In this totalitarian state, they are gradually losing the will to resist, but they still hope that sooner or later this structure will collapse and they will gain their long-awaited freedom.
strings.VOR_Blokhins_grip_warlord_desc:
“So much time wasted, so many missed opportunities for a decent life, so many souls lost...”

These are the thoughts that haunt the slaves—the modern-day prisoners without any rights in the Gulags, forced to work all day and sometimes even at night. In this totalitarian state, they are gradually losing the will to resist, but they still hope that sooner or later this structure will collapse and they will gain their long-awaited freedom.
strings.VOR_Blokhins_grip_russia_desc:
“Is this a bad dream from which I cannot wake up, or rather a nightmare that has become reality?”

These are the typical thoughts of the average, ordinary resident of the Union of Soviet Labor Republics, who have no proper rest. With production quotas forcing them to work six days a week, and compulsory Sunday community clean-up activities, the population is not given a single day to rest. None of them know how long this will last; many continue to live only with a deep hope in their hearts that they will live to see the day of Blokhin's death, so that their suffering and torment may end.

However, with every passing month and year, the situation becomes increasingly hopeless, as deaths from exhaustion, disease, and appalling and unbearable working conditions grow worse and worse. As long as such a ‘securocratic workerist’ regime exists in Russia, as long as the NKVD continues to mindlessly carry out merciless orders from above, as long as the international community turns a blind eye to this – a second ‘Russian Burgundy’ will continue to exist...
strings.VOR_sponsored_joint_labor_desc: Following a meeting of the Presidium, which, against the Secretary’s wishes, adopted the ‘Sponsored Joint Labour’ programme. This involves redirecting part of the state budget towards the restoration of damaged—and, more often than not, completely destroyed—buildings and infrastructure in Western Siberia. The sole reason it was adopted despite the Secretary’s disapproval is the unanimous support among party members for the development of all territories. Although it was not adopted for a year as originally planned, through compromise it was reduced to six months to avoid further straining the already fragile economy.

strings.VOR_Golovko_New_Russian_Army_desc:
The newly reborn Russian Army is showing further new signs of improvement. Thanks to our new training system, which emphasizes coordinated teamwork and tactical flexibility, the troops now work together like clockwork on the battlefield, enhancing their overall effectiveness.

To consolidate these results, volunteers are being selected with ever-greater care through an updated regional recruitment system. We will enlist personnel not based on agreements or outdated practices - such as nepotism - but on practical results. Thus, with a motivated, revitalized force, these soldiers will play a key role in preserving democracy and security in the Russian Federation.

strings.VOR_Yevgeniy_Primakov_hog_desc:
Head of Government
Paternalistic Conservatism
--------------
Primakov has always had a drive within him, for better things for himself and his people. Born in 1929 in Kiev to Jewish parents, he had high hopes for himself in pursuing an academic career. A studious young man, he worked very hard from an early age to be able to learn with the best minds of his generation and do great things. The collapse of the union, however, shattered these dreams for what young Primakov thought would be forever. Spending the remainder of his teenage and early adult years in West Siberia, he climbed the social ladder and got into politics fairly quickly. He did many things in this transitional period he is not proud of, and that would draw scrutiny from the people and any political rivals he acquires. Regardless, after the collapse of the WSSLR, Primakov opted to assist Boris Yeltsin in rebuilding democracy in the wartorn wastes of Russia. Moreover, they found common ground in Admiral Golovko's vision of a promising {vor_getname}, which supported the formation of an opposition. Still, his past will haunt him throughout his career, even if he succeeds in bringing democracy to all Russians.
strings.VOR_maltsevs_plan_category_desc:
Secretary Blokhin, replacing the former corrupt, hated and now scandalous former Minister of Economy Yevgeniy Yudin, gave Maltsev carte blanche for new economic projects. These plans are the most ambitious in the history of our country, which is so far removed from the luxuries of the world's post-industrial civilizations. At stake is not only the solution of logistical problems and the creation of road and rail routes, but also the regional development of regions and their connection to the capital!

Mikhail Maltsev doesn't intend to carry out this “grand construction of the Trans-Ural Railway” on his own, using only his own resources; he will have to balance between various internal political groups. Of course, more than half of the work will be financed from the state budget, but there are some influential private entrepreneurs who want to gain control over certain areas of the construction process of the new logistics connection, especially in the newly gained territories. For them, the minister has specially developed a structure - commissions that will monitor the progress of work on the ground and calculate how much it will cost in financial terms. Finally, we must not forget about the NKVD, which is not averse to using force to make workers work harder...

strings.VOR_mixed_economic_management_assembly_c:
On Mikhail Maltsev's personal initiative, 'Mixed Economic Management Assembly' was formed, a de-facto main body governing the economy of the entire union. According to the plan, this assembly will be an additional means of governing the state, but with limited powers and until the completion of Russia's unification. Here, complaints, reports, and ideas from each region can be heard individually, and collective decisions can be made for the benefit of the Union.

With such a “more democratic” approach, we will gain the legitimacy and approval of the people that we so desperately need, which is an extremely important factor in the short term. The main goal of this initiative, adopted by the secretary, is to surpass the New Economic Policy (NEP) of the 1920s in record time within a few years. The risks associated with capitalization and the opening of the domestic market in the economy are temporary and strictly controlled by the government. Any resemblance to the “Western bourgeois model” is simply propaganda interpretations from “enemies of the regime”, who will be prosecuted and punished for such statements.
strings.VOR_ME_Assembly_information_guide_tt:
Votes can be held on a variety of economic issues through the “Show Motions” button. There are three types of issues that can be addressed: Reforms, Resolutions, and Motions.

Reforms will provide permanent changes to the effects of the national spirit “Mixed Economy Model”. They can only be voted on once the prerequisite reform has been passed and they have been unlocked through a national focus.

Resolutions affect the policies upheld by the Management Assembly and Security Council. They can only be voted on once they have been unlocked through a national focus or event.

Motions are less impactful, and will provide smaller bonuses to the Free Territory. After a motion has been proposed, it cannot be proposed again for 180 days.

Issues will be debated in the Management Assembly for a period of 60 days. If two-thirds of the collective representatives vote in favour of the issue, it will be passed.

Each Collective has a set of workers that will influence how they will vote on different issues. Collectives can be swayed to support an issue through Concessions.

strings.VOR_VEOP_category_desc:
The Voyennaya Ekonomiko-Oriyentirovannaya Programma, prepared by Garanin, has one main goal: to focus our economy primarily on military needs. Although, according to the security minister's interpretation, approximately a quarter of our budget of our annual state budget should be spent on the defense sector and the military. The party, the left and center wings of the NKVD, reacted hostilely to this, fearing excessive funding and allocation of resources to a structure that does not obey them.

After lengthy negotiations and even disputes, a compromise was reached, according to which our army would receive 27.5-35% of the annual budget revenue. This figure may fluctuate due to crises, states of emergency, the outbreak of war, unforeseen socio-economic problems, or the results of the party plenum. In the short term, we will face conflicts over the specifics of budget allocation, excessive bureaucracy, and even bribery, and cases involving the designation of individuals as “enemies of the regime” will fill the offices of NKVD employees. However, it is clear that on the battlefield we will become a much more resilient and formidable opponent for any of our enemies!

strings.VOR_military_dominance_econ_dynamic_modi:
The harsh existence in Russian anarchy demonstrated the weakness of those countries and regimes that did not reorient their economic systems to military needs due to numerous military threats. During our stay in the Russian tundra, locked near the Northern Sea due to constant raids by bandits from the south, we learned this lesson well. It is not so much a question of the security of our regime, nor of restoring the legacy of the USSR, but rather of survival. Because this world lives by the rules of the strong, and the weak are easily subjugated by the former.

That is why Stepan Garanin's initiative received the full support of first the Secretary and then the party. The program to protect the Union from all its enemies is called VEOP (Voyennaya Ekonomiko-Oriyentirovannaya Programma), aimed at rebuilding our economy from civilian needs to military ones, from light industry to heavy industry, and from consumer goods to the transport industry. From now on, our citizens must understand by any means necessary what restrictions must be made in order to continue working without sirens and bombings.

Dear player, thank you for playing this heartfelt mod, and specifically for the original country featured in it - Vorkuta. It took quite a while to develop this country - more than six months - so I hope you weren't disappointed by this fictional in-game country!

strings.VOR_Blokhin_Grip_category_desc:
Chief Vasily Blokhin, who was also the head of the Gulag system in the Northern Urals, was never merciful even to his own citizens, let alone foreigners. His system, built on fear and blood, nevertheless proved to be brutally effective in suppressing any dissent. Other Russian military leaders are concerned about the slow but inexorable transformation of our country into another “Russian Burgundy”, whose population is considered slaves of the bloody secretary, NKVD officer Blokhin.

Through the prism of such a system, our opponents and contenders for control over Russia are confident that sooner or later we will either fall into internal civil war or be unable to effectively repel their invasion. In fact, the secretary is deliberately pursuing a policy of “cleansing Russia from degeneration” because he believes that this has brought Mother Russia to its current state. Only complete devotion to the party, to the leader of the nation, and faith in the ideal of a revolution that will destroy everything non-revolutionary in Russia will ultimately heal it. This is a small price to pay for a safe, stable, and obedient society that would not even dream of the need for dangerous changes or reforms to our communist system, which we will inevitably achieve, regardless of the sacrifices!
strings.VOR_Blokhin_Initial_warlord_repression_t: The Secretary Will Strengthen His Influence in the Northern Ural Soviet Government through Intimidation of Civilians, Sporadic Raids, or Purges in Garrisons!
strings.VOR_Blokhin_Regional_Stage_repression_tt:
The Secretary adheres to several Postulates of his Regime, namely Correctional Labor, Terror Against Dissidents, Generous Rewards for Loyalty to the Military and Elimination of Dissent Among Party Politicians.
This time, the Repressive Apparatus is aimed at:
strings.VOR_Elimination_Dissent_Politicians_Regi: Campaign to Elimination of Dissent Among Party Politicians
strings.VOR_Blokhin_Superregional_Stage_repressi: Due to a combination of factors affecting Secretary Blokhin - such as aging, a paranoid distrust of his staff, and increasingly frequent outbursts of bloodthirsty rage - the next wave of repression is set to unfold
strings.VOR_work_will_set_us_free_tt: Despite State Atheism, Prisoners Will Continue to Believe in Their Gods
strings.VOR_THENEWORDER_DESC:
From its inception, the Vorkuta Gulag served a single purpose: to subject dissidents and criminal leaders from across the USSR to hard labor for the benefit of society. This seemingly protective and corrective goal eventually transformed into an inhumane mechanism for preserving the state's totalitarian apparatus, for which the Vorkuta administration is now “famous.” Acquiring all the current features of total control and forced labor over prisoners in the period from the 1940s to the mid-1950s, Secretary Blokhin earned himself the title of “The Cruelest Boss of the Arctic”.

The most amazing thing in the history of this region is that anyone who challenged the Secretary's authority and control over the Gulag failed. Initially, immediately after the defeat in the Great Patriotic War, Vasily Blokhin, in order to retain his power, formed a temporary partnership in the management of local Gulags with Semyon Zhukovsky, when the latter became disillusioned with Yezhov because of his becoming a servant of Heinrich Yagoda. Together, they successfully secured unquestionable control over prisons and Gulags in the region, relying on NKVD units and divisions. But ironically, Zhukovsky repeated the fate of his former colleague Yezhov, eventually becoming an obstacle to Blokhin's unlimited power. Whether due to paranoia or rumors and reports of Zhukovsky's “Trotskyist views,” this duo was broken up in 1954 when Semyon was shot on Vasily's personal orders.

Since then, a period of instability and general fear has begun in this country, which has become particularly acute after the defeat of the divided Union in the Western Russian War. This was followed by a series of uprisings, thanks to which two large groups of prisoners, dissidents Janis Mendriks and criminal groups Jaba Ioseliani, successfully escaped from Vorkutlag. However, the prisoners' planned overthrow of the tyrannical Secretary never happened, as there were no longer any independent figures in the party's political circle who would seek to overthrow the tyrant, as everyone feared the consequences. Due to this fact, as well as the defeat in the battles for the city of Vorkuta and the strife within the short-lived coalition of dissidents and bandits, the former prisoners left the north, migrating to the south and east.

By the early 1960s, the dark clouds had dispersed over Vorkutlag, the system had survived, and the regime continued to successfully suppress dissent, but on the eastern side of the Urals, bandits were reorganizing their forces. Border clashes and shelling of villages have become much more frequent, and generals on both sides are making loud statements about soon defeating the enemy. The two natural enemies have gathered enough resources and weapons to escalate the old conflict. The mutual hatred is so strong that the fact of weekly German bombings fades into the background in view of the inevitable clash between the Vorkuta Corrective Labor Camp and the Thief Territory of Yugra...
